'''Stormtrooper Squad Dorn-7/325''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of veteran [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] assigned to the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on [[Mentanar Vosk]]. Consisting of ten stormtroopers, they were armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and carried two [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]].
